locator_access.mechanism: 122-bit page number resolved by a 6-level radix walk (fanout 2^21); each level carries a 128-bit anchor in two GPR words with an explicit add/adc carry chain, extracts the radix digit, forms the node slot address and tests the presence tag
locator_access.probe_path_source: experiments/key_equal_v23.py::probe_insert (bucket probe, key compare) and experiments/store_v23.py::anchor_chain_counters (the executed 128-bit anchor chain)

peaks.layout: 85 records per 4096 B page, two streams, 16 B locator entries

rule: 1 Ir = one AArch64 GPR instruction; a register-pair transfer is 16 B
